title: The Constitutional Coverage Trilemma in AI Governance

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating 'menu regret' (the welfare mismatch between user constitutional preferences and available AI profiles) across a five-point political identity scale to determine if current frontier models systematically under-serve specific ideological groups.

Analyzing the correlation between user demographic attributes (age, gender, self-rated tech-literacy) and their constitutional value preferences, and comparing these to the models' default profiles to demonstrate that AI systems disproportionately align with a younger, male, and tech-literate 'builder demographic'.
